Independent training for training providers and corporate teams. Practical exercises, process understanding and certification preparation. Former SAP SE Solution Sales Executive; this is sales experience, not a claim of implementation project delivery.

Training scope

MM / procurement: Requisition to invoice, sources of supply, purchasing, inventory, physical inventory and consumption-based planning. Customizing: organization, master data, valuation and account determination.

SD: The October 2026 CV describes order processing, delivery, billing, pricing and related customizing. Specific courses and depth are agreed individually.

FI integration: Accounting effects of goods movements, invoices and billing. Standalone FI delivery is subject to scope confirmation.
